evals.prompt:
Hey, can you turn this into a Slack message for me?

"Hey team, just a heads-up — we're releasing v2.5 tomorrow morning around 9 AM. Key highlights: brand new analytics dashboard, fixed the login timeout bug that's been annoying everyone, and we've removed the legacy /v1 API endpoints (migrate to /v2 if you haven't already). Please test staging before EOD today and ping @releases-channel if you find anything. Thanks!"
evals.expected_output: A valid Slack Block Kit JSON file (slack-message.json) containing a blocks array with at least one markdown block. The content should be well-structured with the key highlights organised (dashboard, bug fix, API removal), the original meaning preserved, and no unsupported syntax.
assertions: Output file slack-message.json is valid JSON
Top-level key is 'blocks' and its value is an array
Every block in the array has 'type' equal to 'markdown'
Every block in the array has a non-empty 'text' field
No block contains image markdown syntax '![' anywhere in its text
The text mentions 'v2.5' or 'version 2.5' preserving the version number
The text mentions the analytics dashboard
The text mentions the login bug fix
The text mentions the legacy API or v1 API removal
No single block's text field exceeds 12000 characters

evals.prompt:
Please convert this markdown file into a Slack Block Kit payload. The file is at evals/files/eval2-standard-markdown.md

Make sure you handle any Slack-incompatible syntax appropriately.
evals.expected_output: A valid Slack Block Kit JSON file (slack-message.json) where the release notes content is preserved. The image embed should be converted to a hyperlink. The table, code block, blockquote, and lists should all be present. The skill should note what conversions were made.
assertions: Output file slack-message.json is valid JSON
Top-level key is 'blocks' and its value is an array
Every block in the array has 'type' equal to 'markdown'
Every block in the array has a non-empty 'text' field
No block text contains the pattern '![' (image embed syntax)
The converted image URL 'cdn.example.com/images/phoenix-banner.png' appears as a plain link or is referenced in the output
The table with Issue/Severity/Fixed columns is present in at least one block's text
The JavaScript code block (getReport) is present in at least one block's text
The blockquote about backing up configuration files is present
No single block's text field exceeds 12000 characters

evals.prompt:
I need to post a project status update in our #engineering Slack channel. Here's the data:

(contents of evals/files/eval3-structured-data.md)

Please format this as a clean Slack message.
evals.expected_output: A valid Slack Block Kit JSON file (slack-message.json) that presents the structured status data in a readable Slack message. The output should use bold labels, organised sections for status/progress/blockers/next steps, and preserve all the key details including the IT ticket number, owner name, and risk note.
assertions: Output file slack-message.json is valid JSON
Top-level key is 'blocks' and its value is an array
Every block in the array has 'type' equal to 'markdown'
Every block in the array has a non-empty 'text' field
No block contains image markdown syntax '![' anywhere in its text
The project name 'Orion Data Pipeline' appears in the output
The owner 'Sarah Chen' is mentioned
The IT ticket reference 'IT-4482' is preserved
The status 'At Risk' is present in the output
No single block's text field exceeds 12000 characters
